items.title: Mansion for sale
items.summary: Two adjacent charming homes with plenty of possibilities in a prime location in Nieuwpoort – Simli! A unique opportunity in the sought-after Simli neighborhood in Nieuwpoort! Two adjoining, nearly identical homes are now for sale in an absolutely prime location. These properties offer a wealth of possibilities: ideal as a spacious family home, a second home, an investment property, or to combine both homes into one impressive country house! What makes these properties unique? Both homes welcome you with a charming, characterful facade and feature a spacious, light-filled living area with large windows that provide a pleasant connection to the garden. Adjacent to each living area is a well-maintained, fully equipped kitchen. Each home features no fewer than 4 bedrooms, 2 fully equipped bathrooms, a practical garage, and a full basement. Outside, you can enjoy a pleasant garden with a terrace—ideal for relaxing in peace and quiet. The greatest asset of these properties is undoubtedly their versatility. Thanks to their adjacent location and virtually identical floor plans, both homes can—subject to the necessary permits—be combined into a single spacious country home with an exceptional amount of living space. In addition, they also offer interesting possibilities as an investment property, a vacation home, or a combination of personal use and rental. The excellent location in the popular Simli neighborhood, close to the coast, makes this a unique real estate opportunity in Nieuwpoort!
